topics.redstone: The sensor converts detected vibrations to redstone output. A comparator reads vibration frequency. Wool can block vibration paths.
The amethyst side accepts a signal strength that selects the vibration frequency to detect. Outputs provide the detected signal; wool can block vibration paths.

topics.oxidation: Use honeycomb to lock sign editing. Dye changes text color, and glow ink makes the text appear bright. Waxing a sign does not change it into a copper block.
Use honeycomb to lock sign editing. Dye changes text color, and glow ink makes the text appear bright. Waxing a sign does not change it into a copper block.

topics.storage: Your ender chest has 27 personal slots shared across your ender chests in every dimension. Other players see their own inventory, not yours. Breaking the chest does not spill those stored items.
topics.redstone: Hoppers cannot insert or remove ender-chest items, and comparators do not read its contents.
